rationale: A has a distinctive editorial art direction (warm paper ground, serif headline with italic rust accent) and a complete desktop hero where the headline lines rise in sequence and a live code/ledger panel joins them, followed by a pinned payment-flow diagram that advances through its steps as you scroll. B's dark/lime look is more generic, and its desktop hero leaves the right half empty, with the CTA floating oddly mid-right. Several of B's scroll frames (around 8100px and 9450px) are mostly empty, although its four-step payment scrollytelling and lime sign-up finale are strong. B's hover feedback is richer (lime-to-white invert with glow, outlined pills), while A's is limited to thin underlines and a slight darken; both phone layouts are clean.
